short_description: Artisan sustainable floristry and botanical styling for weddings and local events.
full_description: Founded in 2021 by Harriet Vance, The Essex Bloom Studio creates nature-inspired botanical designs using locally grown Essex blooms and eco-conscious packaging. We run seasonal floristry masterclasses and bespoke event styling across Essex.

short_description: Organic sourdough, handcrafted pastries, and community baking workshops in historic Colchester.
full_description: Elena started baking sourdough during maternity leave and has grown Colchester Artisan Bakes into a bustling town-centre bakery and weekend café. Passionate about sourdough culture, heritage grains, and training young apprentices.

short_description: Specialist commercial contract law and HR advisory for female-led SMEs and startups.
full_description: Victoria is a qualified solicitor with over 14 years of commercial experience. Meridian Legal provides transparent, fixed-fee legal audits, contracts, and IP protection designed to demystify law for expanding founders.

short_description: Holistic physiotherapy, trauma-informed pilates, and postnatal rehabilitation studio.
full_description: Overlooking the Thames Estuary, Southend Coastal Wellness is a multidisciplinary sanctuary for women's pelvic health, prenatal movement, and holistic stress recovery. Founded by clinical physiotherapist Chloe Henderson.

short_description: Brand strategy, Shopify e-commerce design, and SEO for independent retail brands.
full_description: A boutique two-founder studio based at Maldon quay. Sophie and Amara help retail brands transition from local market stalls to high-converting international e-commerce stores.

short_description: Zero-waste organic refills, ethical lifestyle essentials, and circular home goods.
full_description: Braintree Eco Pantry was created to make low-waste living accessible and affordable to Essex families. Rachel curates over 400 plastic-free pantry staples, home cleaning refills, and locally made artisan soaps.

short_description: Modern cloud accounting, Xero training, and cash-flow forecasting for creative entrepreneurs.
full_description: Fiona helps female business owners fall in love with their numbers. Ditching corporate jargon, she provides friendly monthly bookkeeping, R&D tax credit assistance, and growth advisory.

short_description: Childhood development advisory, nursery staff training, and inclusive parenting workshops.
full_description: Dr. Natalie Ward brings 20 years of early childhood research to support local nurseries, preschools, and parents. Specialising in neurodivergent inclusion and sensory-friendly learning spaces.
